scope: Guest CP775 batch commands exercise national 8.3 names, alternate case, wildcard selection, DIR name/extension/reverse ordering, COPY/REN/MOVE/XCOPY, nested and empty directories, raw FAT entries and parent links, then fresh-boot reads and cleanup. QEMU HIGH/LOW and real-BIOS IBM AT 286 LOW using the selected retained core. Physical keyboard input, installed paths and source-matched release have separate qualification requirements.
